# Vendored ACS schemas

JSON Schemas from the OWASP Agent Control Standard, `specification/v0.1.0/`, copied verbatim from
[GenAI-Security-Project/agent-control-standard](https://github.com/GenAI-Security-Project/agent-control-standard)
at tag `v0.1.2`, commit `7743826b2ec02e3daf47a08c82170fc7a43b0838`. Licensed under the Apache License 2.0
(see `LICENSE`, also copied from that commit). Not modified; the adapter's validators are generated from these files.
